claims.source: 2026-08-24 novel-chapter-video integration run and buildVideoClipContexts runtime inspection
claims.evidence: The same chapter-level sourceCoveragePlan and sourceFidelityAudit were serialized into every parallel Clip writer even though each writer already receives its frozen beat, spokenScript, object contracts and adjacent sequence obligations.
claims.proposal: Replace the repeated chapter payload with a compact source receipt plus the current beat and adjacent sequence projection. Keep chapter-wide truth in the frozen BeatSheet artifact only.

claims.source: BeatSheet v12 runtime contract and repeated structured-correction failures
claims.evidence: sourceId, sourceFingerprint, protocolVersion, clipIndex, dialogueScript, speakers, exitState, sourceOrder and sourceBeat duration are all reproducible from frozen inputs or the delivered event and speech ledgers.
claims.proposal: Project deterministic copies before versioned validation and keep the model responsible only for semantic source beats, event timing, narrative choices and object-state facts.

claims.source: ProjectContext asset snapshot and chapter integration run
claims.evidence: A ready production-eligible image with an exact kind://canonical-name role is already a deterministic project fact; asking the asset Agent to rewrite prompt and negativePrompt for that same asset adds work without changing the execution decision.
claims.proposal: Partition exact ready reuse roles before Agent dispatch, materialize their plans deterministically and send only unresolved visual roles to the asset Agent.

claims.source: quality platform reconciliation of the 2026-08-24 run
claims.evidence: A single end-to-end threshold did not explain queue delay, BeatSheet wall time, writer wall time, reused/generated asset counts or per-item latency without manual report reconstruction.
claims.proposal: Persist generic stage clocks, item-duration summaries and asset disposition counts as factual evaluation evidence.

mappings.reason: The semantic dimensions do not change, but the writer input owner and carrier become explicitly clip-local. This is a patch-level owner projection clarification, not a new output field.
The final artifact keeps the same facts; only the deterministic owner writes reproducible copies.
Exact canonical identity and ready URL eligibility are deterministic protocol facts; unresolved roles remain Agent-owned.
This changes diagnostics and evaluation evidence, not authoring semantics or runtime generation admission.

contractChanges: Patch tapcanvas/video-prompt-authoring to 2.0.1 and replace beatSheetContext.sourceFidelityAudit writer input with sourceReceipt plus frozen current-beat and sequence projections.
Do not add a semantic quality gate, keyword heuristic, provider constant or new writer output field.
writerChanges: Read only sourceReceipt, current beat, spokenScript, assetObjectContracts and sequenceContext for the assigned Clip.
Keep explicit depictedStoryEventIndices as the authored evidence used by the deterministic coverage compiler.
Do not reconstruct or request the chapter-wide speech/source ledger.
reviewerChanges: Review the assigned Clip against its frozen event and sequence receipts; do not require a duplicated chapter payload.
Keep review evidence non-blocking and inside the same writer context.

conflicts.conflict: Canonical-name equality cannot decide whether a semantically different composition image should replace a stable identity asset.
conflicts.resolution: Only exact kind://canonical-name identity reuse is deterministic. Composition and every unresolved role stay in the Agent path.

conflicts.conflict: A performance threshold must not be relaxed or inferred from incomplete historical attempts.
conflicts.resolution: Diagnostics remain factual; the five-minute assertion stays unchanged and fresh evaluations use a new execution family.

evalCases.purpose: Verify a writer preserves one Clip's story events, speech and adjacent handoff without receiving the chapter-wide ledgers.
Verify source speech coordinates and object exit state remain correct after deterministic projection.
Verify ready character/scene identities are reused while an unresolved composition role remains Agent-authored.
Measure fresh BeatSheet-to-eight-writer critical path with zero media side effects and unchanged five-minute admission.

blindEvaluation.case: 10-second two-event key handoff with one frozen on-screen speech line
blindEvaluation.judgeRationale: Both anonymous outputs fully covered the two events in order, conserved speech coordinates 0..16, closed ten seconds, preserved object and participant state, and introduced no unsupported story, music or captions.
